component.name: AgentScene
component.script: sub init() parent=CreateObject("roSGNode","Group") child=parent.createChild("Rectangle") video=parent.createChild("Video") other=CreateObject("roSGNode","Group") agent=parent.getHttpAgent() print "agent type=";type(agent) print "node access=";GetInterface(parent,"ifSGNodeHttpAgentAccess")<>invalid print "node http=";GetInterface(parent,"ifHttpAgent")<>invalid print "agent http=";GetInterface(agent,"ifHttpAgent")<>invalid expires=CreateObject("roDateTime") expires.FromSeconds(expires.AsSeconds()+3600) agent.EnableCookies() print "add default=";agent.AddCookies([{expires:expires,secure:false,version:0,name:"probe",value:"default",domain:"example.com",path:"/"}]) print "default cookies=";other.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "child cookies=";child.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "video cookies=";video.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() replacement=CreateObject("roHttpAgent") replacement.EnableCookies() print "add replacement=";replacement.AddCookies([{expires:expires,secure:false,version:0,name:"one",value:"replacement",domain:"example.com",path:"/"},{expires:expires,secure:false,version:0,name:"two",value:"replacement",domain:"example.com",path:"/"}]) print "set parent=";parent.setHttpAgent(replacement) print "parent cookies=";parent.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "child inherited=";child.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "video inherited=";video.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "set child=";child.setHttpAgent(agent) print "own child=";child.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "reset child=";child.setHttpAgent(invalid) print "reset inherited=";child.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "reject transfer=";parent.setHttpAgent([]) print "parent unchanged=";parent.getHttpAgent().GetCookies("example.com","/").Count() print "@@PROBE_END" end sub
